data.name: Arvell
data.long_meaning: Arvell is an old English name, derived from the Old English words ‘eorl’ meaning noble or eagle, and ‘wellan’ meaning to boil or brighten. The name Arvell can be interpreted as ‘noble eagle’ or ‘bright one’. It was a popular name in England during the Middle Ages and was given to boys born into noble families.
